scope: Read-only history of queued-message edits, showing original text, immutable before/after changes and the actual frozen execution goal. Bounded scoped pagination retains the initial revision ceiling while new edits arrive. The browser preserves drafts, expanded entries, reading position and copy focus, with explicit error recovery and stale-response guards.
prior_behavior: Every edit was already persisted with prior and new text, but conversation rows only showed an edited badge; users could not inspect the full history in the UI.

coverage: Fixed revision window under concurrent edits
One read snapshot for current text, counts and page
Bounded read without detail hydration or dispatch
Old readonly database without edit table
Readonly HTTP route and static asset
Stable page merging and new-change notice
Same-page retry and direct fresh-range recovery

三页读取无重复遗漏；新修改保留旧查看范围，失败重试保留展开与滚动位置，刷新后显示新修改；两个草稿不变
切换会话关闭旧窗口，迟到的旧读取不会覆盖新会话的修改记录
执行完成后显示真实运行采用的要求；八种主题、宽度和字号布局通过焦点、边界及文字溢出检查，读取复制无写请求
修改保持队列位置、运行身份与后续消息，原发送回执和未发送对话草稿保留
多页面修改冲突保留本页输入，只读核对后明确保存；八种桌面主题与字号布局可操作

iterations.note: The new verifier removed a route handler before its deliberately delayed response finished. It now explicitly waits for delivery before removing interception. The three existing regression suites in this run passed.
The complete history journey passed, followed by addition of a direct latest-range recovery action and clearing content on close.

Browser integration exposed colon-containing copy control IDs interacting with the shared focus-restoration selector. IDs now use selector-safe hyphens. Visual review also replaced latest-turn wording with the actual historical turn status. The final full JavaScript run and history browser suite passed after both fixes.

browser.visual_review: Inspected the original, before/after and actual execution text, desktop dialog scroll and footer, light/dark screenshots, and the final corrected per-turn status. Eight final layout cases assert real 28px controls and text, keyboard focus, visible bounds and no horizontal text overflow.
browser.isolation: Temporary databases with Mock runtime execution. The fixture holds dispatch until explicit test-only release. The verifier saves 24 real edits, injects a page read failure and delayed response, preserves both composer and edit drafts, checks read/copy request methods and validates the actual stored execution goal. No external model or business service is called.
browser.ordering: The three related suites passed before final changes confined to the new history dialog and its tests. The final history suite and full JavaScript regression passed after all application changes.

limits: This is read-and-copy history, not rollback. Started execution requirements remain immutable.
The history list retains its initial revision ceiling, while current content and execution headers reflect each page read. New changes enter the list only after explicit refresh.
Each request returns at most 20 changes. Pages explicitly loaded by the user accumulate only in the current dialog and are cleared on close; no offline history cache was added.
The layout matrix covers 1024/1440 desktop widths and enlarged dialog text/controls, not a claim of uniform page zoom or all device coverage.
Full and focused test counts overlap. Version remains 1.3.0; no publication or repeated fresh installation.
